summary: @RubenVerborgh Blind review is such a joke in communities so small and people presenting on the same lines of research. Yes lets move not just to open review but reject the fundamental flaw of knowledge scarcity. Celebrate acceptance rates rather than rejection rates.
author: Greg McVerry
